title: EIF knowledge-artifact frontmatter
description: Machine-validatable schema for the YAML frontmatter of any knowledge artifact (fact, rule, decision, etc). Mirrors core/ontology/knowledge-types.md#knowledge-artifact-metadata - keep both in sync; this file is the enforceable source, the Markdown is the explained source.

type.description: ontology is reserved for framework-core vocabulary documents (core/ontology/*), not project knowledge artifacts.

status.description: rejected is valid only when type implies a hypothesis-shaped claim (typically assumption); see status-lifecycle.md.

evidence.description: Epistemic label - required once status is not draft. See authority-model.md.

source.description: Channel this artifact came from - distinct from `evidence`, which is the epistemic label.

confidence.description: See confidence-levels.md. Not a verification bypass - check environment/source_version/applies_to before relying on a high-confidence claim in a new context.

environment.description: e.g. staging, prod-eu, local-dev. Optional; recommended for empirical (axis B) artifacts.

source_version.description: Version of the system/library/API this claim was observed against.

applies_to.description: Free-text scope narrowing, e.g. 'Windows only', 'API v2 only'.
